exports.semantics: Returns 1 only when both NUL-terminated strings have identical length and each byte compares equal after the host character-fold helper; otherwise returns 0.

If exclusiveMaximum is 0 returns 0. If exclusiveMaximum <= minimum returns minimum. Otherwise repeatedly draws from the shared host PRNG and accumulates bounded remainders until the result is at least minimum; result remains below exclusiveMaximum.
Instruction-equivalent range routine to _genrdn with the same edge cases and shared host PRNG dependency.

Normalizes and bounds a file pattern into the TFS global buffer, derives its path component, enumerates matching files with _fnd1st/_fndnxt, stores the first search result, sets TFS state to 1 when a match exists or 0 otherwise, and returns the number of matches.

Checks whether the supplied prefix matches the beginning of the active TFS text buffer using _sameto. On match it advances by strlen(prefix), skips whitespace, stores the suffix pointer globally, and returns 1 only when the remaining suffix is non-empty.
If TFS state equals 3, closes/releases the global TFS handle through the host close helper, then unconditionally resets TFS state to 0.

conclusions: Six priority Worldgroup exports now have implementation-level bodies, cdecl ABI evidence, argument positions, return behavior, global-state effects, and direct callee ownership.
_genrdn and _lngrnd are implementation-equivalent and consume the same shared host PRNG routine at VA 0x0044BE08.
The TFS functions form a shared state machine around globals 0x00463DDC, 0x00463F78, 0x00463F7C, 0x00463E68, 0x00463DE0, and 0x00463E64.
limitations: The internal algorithm and seed lifecycle of the shared PRNG callee at 0x0044BE08 remain for the next pass.
Exact structure layout of the find-data block at 0x00463E68 remains partially unresolved.
